one-web-server-surfaces-in-the-shim — ONE web server; a device gets a declared PANE, never its own route/port/server. This replaces, it does not add.
gates: The stdlib http.server is replaced by Starlette + uvicorn. THREE things must hold: (1) existing pane URLs render identically — no regression on current surfaces; (2) WebSocket connection establishes and can receive a server push — the capability the current server lacks; (3) the listener is Starlette's ASGI app run by uvicorn, not custom socket code — the device logic (routing in server.py, rendering in render.py) stays where it is and does not leak into the transport.
